scope.current_head: 914ebf2 Scope short right-click latch to live game input
notices: Investigation only; no Rust code changed and no build or tests run.

A status of unverified is not equivalent to fixed or working.

records.finding: Holding right-click for 2.125-2.161s fired four bolts/reduced arrows 16 to 11 and dealt durability damage 4; reference held for 2.284-2.302s, loaded one projectile only, no damage until release.
records.current_code: pomme-client/src/player/interaction.rs: InteractionState::start_use_item, use_item, update_using_item, release_using_item. use_item has an explicit Bow duration branch but no Crossbow charged-projectile/use-release branch; current click/tick path warrants tracing. Cause not proven.
records.minimum_fix: Implement crossbow charge/release semantics in shared held-use state: start charging on press, do not fire on repeated held frames, send/finish exactly once on release after valid charge.
records.test: Pure state test: press+held across ticks yields no repeated release/fire; release after adequate charge emits one release; insufficient charge and switching item cancel; then local server integration reproduces arrow count/durability.

records.minimum_fix: Add/route shield item icon and first-person blocking transform/pose through existing item model/held-item renderer; do not infer damage blocking from a render-only observation.
records.test: Asset/model lookup test for minecraft:shield GUI and first-person transforms plus visual regression while holding; separately test server-verified damage reduction by direction before claiming functional blocking.
